verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago has a first-party CLI overview page (docs/mp-cli/overview). It says a single token lets you operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual client, or manual HTTP calls, which is the core of an official CLI for agentic or terminal workflows. missing for 10: details on installation, commands, and AI-agent-specific usage; independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
